<style>
/* Global specific layout overrides */
.product-main-grid-container { gap: 5%; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .product-main-grid-container { flex-direction: column; gap: 48px; } }

/* Breadcrumbs */
.stillness-dynamic-product-main .woocommerce-breadcrumb {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: rgba(14,27,48,0.5);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.stillness-dynamic-product-main .woocommerce-breadcrumb a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.3s;
}
.stillness-dynamic-product-main .woocommerce-breadcrumb a:hover {
    color: #0E1B30;
}

/* ----- GALLERY SKINNING ----- */
.product-gallery-sticky {
    position: sticky;
    top: 120px;
    align-self: flex-start;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .product-gallery-sticky {
        position: static;
    }
}
/* Woo Gallery Flex layout to mimic UI (thumbnails on left) */
.product-gallery-sticky .woocommerce-product-gallery {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 16px;
    opacity: 1 !important; /* Force visibility sometimes WooCommerce hides it initially */
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .product-gallery-sticky .woocommerce-product-gallery {
        flex-direction: column-reverse;
    }
}
/* Wrapper for the main image */
.product-gallery-sticky .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4/5;
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(196,187,180,0.2);
}
.product-gallery-sticky .woocommerce-product-gallery__wrapper .woocommerce-product-gallery__image:first-child img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}
/* Thumbnails wrapper */
.product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
    width: 80px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    list-style: none;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs {
        flex-direction: row;
        width: 100%;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
    }
}
.product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs li {
    width: 100% !important; 
    float: none !important;
}
.product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs li img {
    aspect-ratio: 1/1;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0.6;
    object-fit: cover;
}
.product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs li img.flex-active, 
.product-gallery-sticky .flex-control-nav.flex-control-thumbs li img:hover {
    border-color: #688F9D;
    opacity: 1;
}

/* ----- DETAILS SKINNING ----- */
.product-details-content .product_title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 48px;
    color: #0E1B30;
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    line-height: 1.1;
}
.product-details-content .price {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #0E1B30;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    display: block;
}
.product-details-content .woocommerce-product-rating {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(14,27,48,0.7);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.product-details-content .woocommerce-product-rating .star-rating {
    color: #688F9D;
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    width: 5.4em;
}
.product-details-content .woocommerce-product-rating .star-rating span::before {
     color: #688F9D;
}
.product-details-content .woocommerce-product-details__short-description {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: rgba(14,27,48,0.7);
    margin-bottom: 40px;
}

/* ----- ADD TO CART SKINNING ----- */
.product-details-content form.cart {
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}
/* Quantity */
.product-details-content form.cart .quantity {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    border: 1px solid rgba(14,27,48,0.2);
    border-radius: 99px;
    padding: 4px;
    height: 56px;
}
.product-details-content form.cart .quantity input.qty {
    width: 48px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #0E1B30;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    line-height: 48px;
    -moz-appearance: textfield;
}
.product-details-content form.cart .quantity input.qty::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
.product-details-content form.cart .quantity input.qty::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    margin: 0;
}
/* Main Cart Button */
.product-details-content form.cart button.single_add_to_cart_button {
    flex: 1;
    height: 56px;
    background: #688F9D;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 99px;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(104,143,157,0.2);
}
.product-details-content form.cart button.single_add_to_cart_button:hover {
    background: #0E1B30;
}

/* ----- META SKINNING ----- */
.product-details-content .product_meta {
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(14,27,48,0.1);
    padding-top: 24px;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: rgba(14,27,48,0.5);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}
.product-details-content .product_meta a {
    color: #688F9D;
    text-decoration: none;
}
.product-details-content .product_meta a:hover {
    color: #0E1B30;
}
</style>
